The guest instructions still execute in Musashi; native host API handling does not make the guest a source port or ahead-of-time translation. Hosted EmuTOS AES/VDI routines supply graphical APIs without booting an Atari ROM. Terminal usage, headless support and self-hosted retro development tests establish the requested runner category, without implying complete TOS or ST hardware compatibility.

identity.note: Preservation mirror of the original Macintosh Wolfenstein 3D First/Second Encounter source release, attributed in the preserved release note to Bill Heineman and Chris DeSalvo. The note dates the Macintosh commercial release to October 1994 and the source-release account to January 2000; the GitHub root itself is a later third-party archive. WolfMain.c implements the level/game loop, player/enemy/projectile movement and game progression.

source_cpu.note: The release note explicitly distinguishes Macintosh 68000 and PowerPC editions. These independently establish both source families; the SNES ancestry does not become a claimed source binary platform for this Mac archive.
